body:
BREAKING | Nepal / South Asia
NEPAL FLOOD DEATH TOLL NEARS 1,400 AS SEARCH FOR THOUSANDS CONTINUES

Nepal’s NDRRMA reported Tuesday that Aug. 26 flash floods claimed about 1,395–1,399 lives, with missing figures at roughly 5,130–5,170. Linked to an ice-rock avalanche / glacier collapse near the Nepal–Tibet border along the Bhotekoshi–Trishuli corridor; 13,700+ rescued. Only ~104 bodies identified so far. Dual-country dead-or-missing tallies above 7,000 remain provisional.

Sources: The Hindu (PTI) https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/nepal-flash-floods-death-toll-update/article71469850.ece ; Everest Times https://www.everest-times.com/2026/09/15/31759/

EVERGREEN | Nepal / India / South Asia
KATHMANDU SHIFTS TOWARD RECOVERY AS INDIA RUSHES POWER EXPORTS

Nepal moving from rescue to reconstruction. Preliminary RDNA rebuild bill ~723.3B NPR (~$4.8B); 12+ hydropower plants swept away. India approved up to 654 MW exports for 18 hours/day through Dec. 31. Kathmandu has sought UN Loss and Damage Fund support.

Sources: DW https://www.dw.com/en/nepal-thousands-still-missing-as-flood-recovery-begins/a-79259980 ; Reuters https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/india-approves-export-power-nepal-after-deadly-flood-2026-09-14/

BREAKING | Pakistan / South Asia
PAKISTAN ISSUES FRESH FLOOD ALERTS AS MONSOON RAINS RETURN

NDMA/PMD warn of rain through ~Sept. 17: urban flooding, flash floods, landslides risk in GB, KP, Punjab, Kashmir, NE Balochistan. PM Shehbaz directed full NDMA–provincial relief coordination.

Sources: WE News https://wenewsenglish.com/pakistan-braces-for-more-rain-as-authorities-warn-of-floods-and-landslides/

BREAKING | Middle East / Red Sea
HOUTHIS PRESS RED SEA COAST AS SAUDI ARABIA SOUNDS WIDE ALERTS

Houthis struck Saudi targets and tightened hold on Yemen’s Red Sea coast near Bab el-Mandeb. Saudi alerts briefly covered Mecca/Jeddah; Brent above $108 amid Hormuz + Red Sea pressure.

Source: Reuters https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/houthis-strike-saudi-targets-anew-talks-over-strait-hormuz-stall-2026-09-15/

BREAKING | Yemen / Horn of Africa
U.N.: MORE THAN 100,000 DISPLACED AS YEMEN FIGHTING SURGES

UNHCR: 100,000+ internally displaced; thousands fled by sea to Djibouti. Saudi–Egypt leaders called for free navigation through Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb.

Source: Reuters https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/yemen-conflict-displaces-over-100000-people-un-says-2026-09-15/

BREAKING | Ukraine / Europe
UKRAINE CLAIMS DONETSK PUSH AS ZELENSKYY CONDITIONS ENERGY TRUCE

Brig. Gen. Biletskyi: Third Army Corps “Vivaldi” offensive in N. Donetsk (claims unverified by Reuters). Zelenskyy conditions energy-truce pause on lasting Russian halt to infrastructure strikes.

Sources: Reuters https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-launches-offensive-push-north-donetsk-region-senior-commander-says-2026-09-15/ ; Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/15/zelenskyy-says-ukraine-will-pause-attacks-if-russia-spares-infrastructure

BREAKING | DR Congo / Central Africa
KINSHASA PROTESTS MET WITH TEAR GAS OVER THIRD-TERM FEARS

Police used tear gas as hundreds protested constitutional changes critics say could enable a third Tshisekedi term. ≥10 reported arrested. Ebola “world’s worst” claim — health desk to confirm separately.

Source: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/15/police-crack-down-on-protests-against-constitutional-change-in-dr-congo

EVERGREEN | Nigeria / Africa
DANGOTE OPENS AFRICA’S LARGEST REFINERY TO ‘PEOPLE’S IPO’

Retail IPO seeking ~$1.6B; valuation near $49B. Min. bundle ~5,250 naira (~$4) for 10 shares; Dangote retains ~87%. Plant ~650,000 bpd.

Source: France 24 (AP) https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20260915-nigeria-s-dangote-refinery-launches-biggest-african-ipo-for-retail-investors

EDITOR’S BOX — What to watch next on Nepal floods

Watch NDRRMA body-ID / DNA backlog, tunnel & hydropower worker searches, winter resettlement in Rasuwa–Nuwakot–Dhading. Track India’s power-export deliveries vs. Nepal load, Loss and Damage Fund replies ahead of PM Shah’s expected UNGA ~Sept. 24. Print lock: dead 1,395–1,399; missing ~5,130–5,170 until one official bulletin.
